verdict.rationale: Proa documents rendering one typed component to several targets beyond HTML: a Markdown target (`render_md`, the paired `/index.md` view) and a claim of 'other render targets'. That is a first-party multi-target component model, but there is no evidence that developers can author their own renderer for an arbitrary new platform; the HTTP-server adapter crate is a different capability and is not credited. missing for 10: documented API for writing custom renderers or new render targets, examples of non-HTML/Markdown platform targets, independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a developer, I can write custom renderers so the framework's component model can target platforms other than the browser DOM

citations.quote: HTML, Markdown, and other render targets, from one typed component.
enable the core crate's `html-to-markdown` feature and delegate with `proa_core::to_markdown(self).render_md(cx)`
Refresh the browser and open /index.md to see both representations.
